t: You're looking at the Swedish Church in Marylebone, a Lutheran church. Its name comes from Ulrika Eleonora, who was Queen of Sweden from the end of 1718 until she abdicated in February 1720 in favour of her husband, Frederick. When he took the throne as King Frederick the First, she served as his queen consort until her death in 1741. That royal link is why her name is attached to this place.
